content.short: Neptune Mutual is a decentralized parametric insurance protocol.
content.description: Neptune Mutual automates payouts by using predefined parameters rather than evaluating each claim individually. When an incident affecting a protocol is resolved, all policyholders within that protocol receive payouts according to the established parameters. This system removes the need for individual claim assessments, streamlines the claims process, and tends to be faster and more reliable, ensuring policyholders are compensated in a predictable and transparent manner.
